description: Signal component that transforms raw market tick data into normalized features (OBI, TFI, EMA bias, volume spike, volatility, depth imbalance, macro sync) for downstream decision making.

imports.description: Raw tick data with price, bid/ask sizes, buy/sell volumes

exports.description: Computed features including OBI, TFI, delta_price, liquidity_kappa, and Phase 1 metrics (ema_bias, volume_spike, volatility_state, depth_imbalance, macro_sync)
